fields.label: Version
fields.description: Monotonic integer within a strategy, starting at 1. Never reused, never renumbered — a user's pin is this number.

fields.label: Status
fields.description: draft = editable, never runs. published = frozen, on the shelf. retired = frozen, off the shelf, still runs for whoever pinned it. blocked = frozen and FORCE-STOPS every bot running it. Transitions are enforced by rforex.strategy_spec.can_transition.

fields.label: Spec (JSON)
fields.description: The complete parameter set a bot reads. Validated by rforex.strategy_spec.validate_spec on every save and frozen the moment the version leaves draft.

fields.label: Spec Checksum
fields.description: SHA-256 of the canonicalised spec, written on save. A running bot can compare it to what it loaded and refuse to trade if the two disagree — immutability you can check, not just promise.

fields.label: Blocked Reason
fields.description: Shown to every user whose bot this stops. Required when blocking: a bot that stops without saying why is indistinguishable from a bot that crashed.

fields.label: Change Notes
fields.description: What changed against the previous version, in the user's language. This is the copy shown next to an upgrade offer, so it has to explain a decision, not a diff.
